name: Kikuchi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kikuchi city emblem in blue and light blue: a blue disc with light blue stylised feathers.
history: Municipal flag of Kikuchi, a city in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 2005.

features.role: Kikuchi city emblem — a blue disc with light blue stylised feathers
